status: REGISTERED 2026-11-23 after the driver fixtures (1,152 runs on cuda2), before any recorded run; no timing of this experiment was read before registration
host: cuda2 only, GPU 0 (RTX 2080 Ti), one session. No number is compared with a cuda5 (RTX 4070) number; this is a separate, labelled table
why_cuda2: cuda5's GPU was held by another user's job for more than 6 hours on 2026-11-23, two days before the deadline
questions: Do several queries in flight on streams raise range scorer v3's throughput at k=1000?
How does v3 compare with the compact guarded-FP32 GPUSparse adaptation at k=10 and k=100, batch 1?
not_included: GPUSparse at k=1000 (the adaptation accepts k <= 128) and batch-500 (no batch mode found in this repository's adaptation; the paper's number is another implementation, hardware and protocol)
inputs: full collection, 500 calibration queries; hashes pinned in code/run.py; W=4096 index built here from the pinned GSP, required equal to 06368cee
configurations: code/run.py CONFIGS; v3 W=4096, 256 threads, RADIX_MIN_K 1 (the timed u4m settings); GPUSparse adapter unchanged (block_pl 512, batch 1), pinned package versions
driver: src/cuda_range_v3_batch.cu launches cuda_range_v3.cu's kernel unchanged; each query in flight owns every mutable buffer
correctness: every configuration and every timing process equals the CPU oracle in all rows; VERIFY 2 (poisoned buffers, counter and theta re-armed) for the in-flight driver
timing: 3 processes, 3 warm-up + 20 measured rounds, rotating order; eligibility and replacement as in code/run.py (pinned-core rule of 2026-11-19-prune-batch amendment 1 plus the hyperthread sibling)
numa: host thread on NUMA node 1 (the GPU's node), least-busy of CPUs 3..19 odd; sampler on CPU 1
decision_rule: streams is faster than one at a time at k=1000 if the b32 interval lies wholly above 1; otherwise no demonstrated gain. Everything else is descriptive
limits: both batch-1 scorers time host query construction to host results, but GPUSparse runs in Python/PyTorch
calibration queries only; the 6,480 evaluation queries are not used

amendments.consequence: run -02 starts from the beginning: build, rejections, correctness and all 21 timing processes. -01 stays on record and is not analysed; none of its timings were read. Indexes load before the gate releases a process. Result files are flushed between queries or batches, outside the per-query and per-batch timers, but on network storage this can lengthen the gaps between them
